Fix is test-only in frontend/e2e/audit-timeline.spec.ts: keep mount GETs at 503 until the explicit retry. Target spec passed 3 consecutive local runs after fix. Combined audit+auth suite still has an unrelated auth flake. Local commit aaf39a1 lives in worktree C:/Users/arnutt.n/AppData/Local/Temp/opencode/jsk-e2e-transient; push failed because DNS cannot resolve github.com. Full baseline report and raw JSON are in .audit/perf-baseline-20261123: C1 one SELECT and full row bytes per attachment with p95 up to 1961 ms on 3 mixed files; C2 about 6 SQL per reminder and conflicts remove that row; C3 inconclusive for true scheduled-to-start because live scheduler raced the probe; C4 9 API requests per detail visit with audit logs fetched before tab open. Machine was busy, CPU roughly 46-56%, free RAM 1.7 GB, so small latency gaps are not signal.
